name: Fullscreen Dialog
description: A dialog that occupies the entire viewport with a header close button for immersive tasks.

anatomy.description: The always-visible top bar with the title and a close button, naming the dialog.
The scrollable main area that fills the viewport for immersive content.
Optional action row for the task's primary and secondary actions.

dos: Use for dense editors and settings flows that benefit from the whole viewport.
Prefer it over a sized dialog on small screens where a fixed panel would cramp the task.
Keep a visible close path; the header close button is built in.
donts: Don't use it for short confirmations or single-value captures; use Dialog or PromptDialog.
Don't nest another fullscreen overlay inside it.
Don't make the body scroll the header away; the header stays sticky for orientation.

examples.title: Fullscreen editor
examples.description: A sticky header, scrollable body, and footer actions fill the viewport.

examples.title: Settings flow
examples.description: Dense settings forms get the whole screen to breathe.

guidance.useWhen: Immersive tasks on small screens or dense editors (settings, rich forms) that need the full viewport.
guidance.avoidWhen: Short confirmations or single-value captures; use Dialog, AlertDialog, or PromptDialog instead.
guidance.behavior: Modal dialog semantics: focus is trapped, Escape closes, and the header close button is always visible.
guidance.responsive: Always full viewport by definition; the header collapses gracefully so the body keeps scrolling on short screens.

keyboard.action: Closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger.
Cycles focus through the controls inside the dialog.

notes: Renders with role="dialog" named by its title in the sticky header.
The close button carries an accessible label via the closeLabel prop.

props.description: Accessible label for the close button.
props.name: closeLabel

props.description: Supporting text rendered under the title.
props.name: description

props.description: Action area rendered at the bottom of the dialog.
props.name: footer

props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.
props.name: onOpenChange

props.description: Title rendered in the header; also the accessible name of the dialog.
props.name: title
